source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Telnet, PuTTY, and Secure Shell (SSH)' of 1.11 as printed (PDF 18, printed 13).

blocks.text: Telnet is used for remote device access. It sends data without encryption. PuTTY is a popular tool for remote login. SSH is a secure method for remote access. SSH encrypts data for safety. These tools help manage network devices.
